SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN group_name REGEXP '^[0-9]+-[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(group_name,'-',-1) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE 0 END),0) FROM pm_project_plan_group WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND phase=#{phase}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_plan WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND plan_code=#{planCode}
SELECT id FROM pm_project_plan WHERE parent_id=#{planId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pm_project_plan SET phase=#{phase} WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT id,display_name FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND id IN #{id}

SELECT p.id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_member m WHERE m.project_id=p.id AND m.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0) AS member_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_plan pl WHERE pl.project_id=p.id AND pl.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND pl.deleted=0) AS plan_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_plan pl WHERE pl.project_id=p.id AND pl.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND pl.status='COMPLETED' AND pl.deleted=0) AS completed_plan_count,(SELECT AVG(pl.progress) FROM pm_project_plan pl WHERE pl.project_id=p.id AND pl.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND pl.deleted=0) AS plan_progress FROM pm_project p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_plan WHERE id=#{planId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT planned_start_date,planned_end_date FROM pm_project_plan WHERE id=#{planId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT id,parent_id,planned_start_date,planned_end_date FROM pm_project_plan WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND group_id=#{groupId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pm_project_plan_org WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT po.org_id,po.party_type,o.org_name FROM pm_project_plan_org po JOIN sys_org o ON o.id=po.org_id AND o.tenant_id=po.tenant_id AND o.deleted=0 WHERE po.plan_id=#{planId} AND po.tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY po.party_type,po.org_id
SELECT id FROM pm_project_plan WHERE parent_id=#{planId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
